QuestInfo.name: More Dirt on Hazard
QuestInfo.0: The note's blank. Radio Cony for some intel.
QuestInfo.1: To get the poison outta this note, you'll have to defeat #r30 of Hazard's Mean Cronies#k and get #b15 Poison Removers#k from 'em.
QuestInfo.2: That Poison Remover really did the trick! The writing's legible now. Better return to the hideout.

0.msg: #b(You tell Coney you found a purple document that appears to have Mr. Hazard's secret account info, but the purple color is too saturated for the words to be legible.)#k\r\n

1.msg: It's purple? Ah, it could be because of the poison gas that filled up the hideout.\r\n

2.msg: The poison permeated the p-paper. We might be able to see the writing if we remove the poison... but we'd need a special substance for that.\r\n

3.msg: Maybe there's something nearby... Ah, Mr. Hazard's goons used #i4036152:# #bPoison Remover#k to clean the hideout... Why don't we use that?\r\n

0.msg: Just spray the remover on the paper. About #b15#k doses of #i4036152:# #bPoison Remover#k should do the trick. I'd start by searching #rHazard's Mean Cronies#k.\r\n
I'm s-s-sorry. You should be able to rely on me.\r\n
Popoh, do you think the words will be revealed once we spray the paper?\r\n

1.msg: #b(The Poison Remover cleans the page, revealing Mr. Hazard's secret trading partners, as well as when and where he met them.)#k\r\n

3.msg: It's just as Coney said. This is the secret account. I need to take this to the boss. Mission accomplished!\r\n
